title: Peterwolf's Railroad One
description: More realistic railways with smooth 2×2 & 3×3 curves and Y-shaped switches instead of vanilla T-junctions.
body:
# Peterwolf’s Railroad One

Minecraft railways have barely changed since the early days of the game. Sharp 90-degree turns and T-shaped junctions may work, but they rarely look like a real railway.

Peterwolf’s Railroad One improves vanilla rail building by adding smoother track geometry while keeping the simplicity of the original rail system.

## Features

Smooth Rail Curves

Build realistic railway turns using dedicated curved track pieces:

* 2×2 rail curve
* 3×3 rail curve

Instead of forcing trains through a sharp one-block corner, tracks can now follow a wider and more natural path.
## 
## Realistic Y-Shaped Switch

Replace the vanilla T-junction with a railway-style turnout.

The switch uses a smooth Y-shaped design similar to real railroads, allowing trains to leave the main line and enter a siding without the unnatural appearance of vanilla intersections.

### Redstone Control

Switches can be controlled using Redstone:

* No Redstone signal → train continues on the main line
* Powered → train is diverted to the siding

Simple, intuitive, and fully compatible with existing Redstone systems.

## Vanilla-Friendly Design

Peterwolf’s Railroad One focuses on doing one thing well:
**
Making Minecraft railways look better without introducing complex mechanics, large multiblock systems, or industrial automation.**

If you want more realistic rail networks while keeping the lightweight feel of vanilla Minecraft, this mod is for you.

### Perfect For

* Passenger railways
* Freight railways
* Mining rail networks
* Railway stations
* Realistic transport systems
* Survival and creative worlds

Build smoother tracks. Build better railways.
